summary: Launch Two Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K after an October 8, 2026 extraordinary general meeting approving an Extension Amendment extending the business-combination period monthly up to six times, from October 9, 2026 to April 9, 2027, or an earlier board-determined date. Concurrently the company signed Non-Redemption Agreements with holders of 4,481,851 Class A shares, who agreed not to redeem and to vote for the extension; Launch Two Sponsor LLC agreed to transfer an aggregate of shares to those investors. No combination target, price, or premium was disclosed. Watch sponsor forfeiture economics and remaining trust overhang.
